Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.state

Class ProcessedFileRecord

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.state.ProcessedFileRecord
public final class ProcessedFileRecord extends Object
Immutable value object representing the audit state of a single processed file.

Instances are created either programmatically via the static factory of(String, String, ProcessingStatus) or by Jackson during deserialisation from the JSON state store.

Thread safety: this class is immutable – all fields are final and no mutating methods are exposed. Safe for concurrent read access without external synchronisation.

JSON shape


 {
   "filePath"        : "/reports/index.html",
   "contentHash"     : "a3f5…",
   "status"          : "SUCCESS",
   "processedAt"     : "2024-06-01T10:15:30Z",
   "errorMessage"    : null
 }

    • of

      public static ProcessedFileRecord of(String filePath, String contentHash, ProcessedFileRecord.ProcessingStatus status)
      Creates a record stamped with the current UTC instant and no error message.
      Parameters:
      filePath - absolute or project-relative path of the HTML file
      contentHash - SHA-256 hex digest of the file's contents
      status - processing outcome
      Returns:
      new ProcessedFileRecord

    • failed

      public static ProcessedFileRecord failed(String filePath, String contentHash, String errorMessage)
      Creates a ProcessedFileRecord.ProcessingStatus.FAILED record with an error message.
      Parameters:
      filePath - path of the HTML file that failed
      contentHash - SHA-256 hex digest at the time of the attempt
      errorMessage - description of the failure; truncated to 2 000 chars
      Returns:
      new ProcessedFileRecord
